about: The size budget's baseline (`npm run sizes`, scripts/sizes.mjs, PLAN.md 19ai-5). A file not
named here stays at or under 100 KB (one a PR made or grew past 40 KB is a warning; 19ai-5d).
A file in `files` is over 100 KB and may not grow past the
bytes written beside it: new code for it goes in a module beside it. `ledgers` grow by
design with every PR and are exempt until split. Against the base this only shrinks: an
entry lowered or dropped, never raised, and added only for a file a move carried bytes into
(its own size, with the ceilings in all no higher than the base's; 19ai-3). `npm run sizes
-- --update` lowers it to the tree; nothing raises it. Recorded from main at b38801e, 2026-10-28.

ledgers.PLAN.md: The plan's index since 19m: the order of work and the running order every PR writes in. Its sections are files under docs/plan/, cut into parts of about 30 KB.
ledgers.docs/judging.md: Every PR the owner must look at adds a section here.
ledgers.docs/guide.md: Every feature writes what it does here (README.md); to be split by part of the app.
ledgers.CHANGELOG.md: Every release adds its entry at the top.
ledgers.scripts/checks.json: Every new check is one entry here (PLAN 19k), never a step in the workflow.
